description: Defines the XUnitPt struct representing a measurement value in points with conversion properties and methods.

classes.name: XUnitPt
classes.description: Represents a value with a unit of measure in points, with conversion utilities and operator overloads.

methods.name: XUnitPt
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a double value representing points.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the value with 'pt' unit.

methods.name: FromPoint
methods.description: Creates an XUnitPt from a point value.

methods.name: FromInch
methods.description: Creates an XUnitPt from an inch value, converting to points.

methods.name: FromMillimeter
methods.description: Creates an XUnitPt from millimeter value, converting to points.

methods.name: FromCentimeter
methods.description: Creates an XUnitPt from centimeter value, converting to points.

methods.name: FromPresentation
methods.description: Creates an XUnitPt from presentation units (1/96 inch), converting to points.
